clue.text: Discovering mailbag has them horrified

indicators.note: discovering means uncovering, so the letters are found lying inside the run of words mailbag has them

explanation.walkthrough: 'Discovering' signals the answer sitting across the words mailbAG HAS Them.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe being filled with shock and dismay, so they are straightforward synonyms.

clue.text: She collapsed in a sharp fall, tending to Bond

clue.text: Tougher runner gets date for second of runs

explanation.definitionFit: Hardier means more robust and able to endure harsh conditions, so it is a comparative of tough.

clue.text: Candidates chosen for spirit and inclination

explanation.walkthrough: 'spirit' and 'inclination' look like personal qualities; they are a shot of whisky and a ship's lean.
explanation.definitionFit: A selection of the strongest applicants drawn up for final consideration is the set of chosen candidates.

clue.text: Soldiers may rely on one before going for a dip

definitions.text: Soldiers may rely on one before going for a dip

parts.words: Soldiers may rely on one before going for a dip

explanation.walkthrough: In Britain 'soldiers' are thin fingers of toast dipped into a soft-boiled egg; the egg must be boiled for the right minutes first, hence the little sand-glass.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen sand-glass or timer measures the minutes a boiled egg needs, ready for toast soldiers to dip.

clue.text: People who protect by deploying large guns around huntress

clue.text: Catches people sleeping rough missing mass

clue.text: First broadcaster to ruin Tory independent

clue.text: Puzzle of theologian enveloped in anger

clue.text: Opening sauce giving special appeal

clue.text: Instrument from hospital wing operating primarily intensive care areas

clue.text: A carbon free bitter

clue.text: Son inclined to be awkward in delivery

clue.text: Abandon hope, swapping broadcast for crude strip

clue.text: Success covering globe to become less convincing

clue.text: Do better than new scan in vogue

clue.text: Gets tired, with joint leader at sea

clue.text: Popular and fashionable field for a pagan

clue.text: Island's fortune reversed by a lucky leader

clue.text: Songbirds flying loose around Rhode Island
